method: Three targeted initial ITT comparisons with frozen admitted PM versus empty PM; same model/system prompt/core input; one sample per condition, normal format retries. No SQL execution, answer checking or causal success-rate claim.

cases.without_pm: Locate incident-associated final alert, then extract its IP.
cases.with_pm: Query SigninLogs using known seed IP 95.202.65.202; omits locating the final alert.

cases.judgment: Useful table/field grounding, conditional on source alignment
cases.without_pm: Query proxy logs by host; no schema references.
cases.with_pm: DeviceNetworkEvents filtered by DeviceName, reads RemoteUrl and related fields.
cases.risk: DeviceNetworkEvents is endpoint network data; proxy-log correspondence and maliciousness must still be verified.

cases.without_pm: Four tasks across process chain, curl, WMI and alerts.

conclusion: Some PMs improve concrete task grounding; current selection can also redirect planning to a wrong known-value lookup. Admission rate cannot stand in for planning usefulness.
